digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model selection system
propositions: Rebar's per-pass model selection is inferred from equality tests rather than explicit configuration, causing silent downgrade failures when non-default model IDs are used

Pass-1 model-ladder finders in plan-review resolve to direct Anthropic instead of respecting the configured provider (41 of 42 calls in real runs), creating a split-brain dispatch when Bedrock is configured
A single scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL knob cannot express the per-tier mapping required for trivial/standard/frontier model classes across four verification passes

Class name reserved values must be resolved at three independent call sites (config.resolve_model, ladder expansion, verifier path) without creating a module-level import cycle, requiring a dedicated resolve function rather than a single funnel
Deep merging of REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointer values over discovered config is required so an environment override of one class field does not lose sibling fields like provider and fallback chains
Array replacement (not append) of fallback chains in layered config ensures CI can disable or reorder fallbacks explicitly, including setting fallback = [] to fail loudly
